name: Loading, empty and error states
summary: One AsyncContent wrapper that renders a skeleton, a recoverable error, an empty state with an action, or the content.
description: Every page or card that loads data needs all four states. Skeleton mirrors the content's shape while loading; Empty covers both failures (role=alert, destructive media tint, with Retry) and empty collections (with the create action).
whenToUse: Any view backed by async data.
whenNotToUse: Inline field validation (use Input invalid + Alert in forms).
Transient success/failure notices after an action (use Toast).

composition.role: App-level helper (in the example) switching on a LoadState union

children.role: error: role=alert, EmptyMedia with bg-destructive/10 text-destructive, Retry Button in EmptyContent
empty: EmptyMedia variant=icon, primary create Button in EmptyContent

layout: Render states in the same box the content will occupy, so the page does not jump.
Distinguish "no records yet" (empty state + create action) from "no matches" (DataTable emptyMessage + clear filters).
responsive: Empty is centered and width-agnostic; Skeleton rows should use the same responsive grid as the content.
accessibility: Loading container: role=status aria-live=polite with a visually hidden "Loading…".
Error container: role=alert so the failure is announced.
Retry is a real Button that re-runs the request; keep the user's filters and input.
antiPatterns: A full-page spinner for a partial reload.
Blank screens when a list is empty.
Error text with no recovery action.
